scope: level circuit and pit lane, white lines, model-derived low kerbs and gravel/painted runoff, pit wall and one Bluenight banner; no new grass, buildings or stands
groundReference: asphalt top; surface is 0.25 studs above the grass plate

pitLane.layout: model-derived outer T15 entry blended into the retained widened parallel pit straight and exit

limitations: Flat racing variant; source banking and elevation are intentionally absent.
Rectangular pieces retain small overlaps and angular outside edges; the asphalt top planes are level.
Kerb side, extent and stripe colour and runoff bands come from the supplied model, projected onto the widened CSV layout; no survey or recent imagery validation.
Kerbs retain a custom low ramp and tapered ends for driving; widths, profiles and runoff boundaries are approximations.
Paint is 0.004 studs above the road to remain visible.
Game server saving and live driving still need verification.
Runoff footprints are tidied adaptations of the model, including filled grass slivers; horizontal colour bands use 0.001-stud offsets between -0.008 and -0.004 to avoid flicker at overlaps.

pitEntry.method: Continue from the confirmed middle-of-corner point into the model outer curve; shorten the approach and blend into the retained pit straight at the confirmed former-apron position.

banner.method: One rectangular banner laid flat on the grass inside the topmost corner shown in banner area.png, readable from the model main-grandstand side.
banner.approximation: Three-colour bitmap sampled from the supplied image and merged into horizontal rectangular plain Parts on the inside-corner grass. No uploaded image or decal is required.

accessoryCleanup.method: Close road-to-runoff and inter-band slivers, discard isolated thin fragments, smooth sampled boundaries and combine compatible sections into larger blocks. Runoff overlaps sit just below the asphalt and kerbs.
